display_name: James the Brother of the Lord

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 23 octombrie, «Sfântul Apostol Iacob, ruda Domnului, primul episcop al Ierusalimului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος και Αδελφόθεος πρώτος επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 23 октября ст. ст., «Апостол Иаков, брат Господень», with the rank word left off; the kinship clause is part of the name the calendar gives him, and the line itself declines it as «Апостола Иакова , брата Господня по плоти».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 23. октобар ст. ст., „Св. апостол Јаков брат Господњи.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «апостол» is the `apostle` grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off; «брат Господњи» STAYS, because it is the by-name the calendar gives and section 6 asks for the fullest form it prints. It is also what keeps this form out of the fold: the bare «Јаков» is held in sr by six folders and the gate already prints that fold as read with a key, which a seventh holder would have forced to be deleted and rewritten. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for the stored form.

feast.note: His life pages head «Дни памяти: 4 января (70 ап.) , 23 октября , 28 декабря» — the synaxis of the Seventy Apostles and the Sunday after the Nativity beside this day. One row per church is the schema, so the two other days are recorded here and he does not render on them.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 октября ст. ст. — «Апостола Иакова , брата Господня по плоти (ок. 63).»

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος και Αδελφόθεος πρώτος επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2792/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man. Its heading prints «(; - 62)», so a `dates` object with the death year alone is proposed. The page is careful about the kinship — «Η συγγενική του, όμως, σχέση με τον Κύριο δεν είναι ομόφωνα καθορισμένη», the relationship is not unanimously settled — and that caution is carried into the life rather than resolved. It names two further commemorations, neither of them a second fixed day this schema could hold: the Sunday after the Nativity, kept with David the Prophet and Joseph the Betrothed, and a synaxis at his church inside the Theotokos of the Chalkoprateia. The same day's listing also carries «Ανακομιδή Ιερών λειψάνων του Αγίου Ιακώβου του Δίκαιου» (`https://www.saint.gr/1750/saint.aspx`), whose whole text is «Βλέπε 22 Μαΐου» — a translation of relics, which is not a folder, and which this reader did not follow to 22 Μαΐου. Its Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, and its Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, are taken, both naming him; the Οἶκος is not a kind the schema holds. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 05.11.2025 (23. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостол Јаков брат Господњи.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4). The URL year is 2025, as `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. «апостол» is the `apostle` this folder holds, the thirty years at Jerusalem the `bishop` and the `office` it already carries, and the death the `martyr`; `types` untouched. SECTION 6 IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS DAY AND THE BY-NAME IS KEPT. The bare «Јаков» is held in sr by SIX folders already — `james-of-nisibis`, `james-of-samosata`, `james-of-studion`, `james-son-of-alphaeus`, `james-son-of-zebedee` and `james-the-confessor` — and the gate prints that six-folder fold as READ, with a key. The bare «Игњатије» became a read TWO-folder fold three days ago, on the Julian 20 October, when `ignatius-of-stara-zagora` took it beside `ignatius-of-rostov`. Storing a bare forename on either folder here would have widened a key that is already read and forced its deletion and replacement. Both of this day’s headings give a by-name — «брат Господњи» and «Цариградски» — and section 6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives, so both are kept and the day writes no key and deletes none. That is not a convenience: it is the rule, and the fold it did not make is the measurement. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND AN AGE REFUSED. The folder holds `death` «62 or 63». The entry closes «Беше Јакову 63 године када пострада за Господа свога» — SIXTY-THREE YEARS OLD, which is AN AGE and not a year, and the coincidence that 63 is also one end of the interval on file makes it no more usable. «Био епископ у Јерусалиму 30 година» is a length of office and not a date either. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND THE FIRST OF IT IS WHY HE IS CALLED WHAT HE IS CALLED. He is named the Brother of the Lord because he was a son of the righteous Joseph, the betrothed of the Theotokos — and the entry tells the story behind it: WHEN JOSEPH WAS DYING HE DIVIDED HIS PROPERTY AMONG HIS SONS AND WISHED TO LEAVE A PORTION TO THE LORD JESUS AS WELL, AND ALL THE BROTHERS OPPOSED IT, NOT RECKONING JESUS THEIR BROTHER; JAMES LOVED JESUS GREATLY AND DECLARED THAT HE WOULD TAKE HIM ON HIS OWN PORTION. THAT IS WHY HE IS CALLED THE BROTHER OF THE LORD. By tradition HE WENT INTO EGYPT WITH THE VIRGIN AND JOSEPH when Herod sought to kill the newborn King. Of his life: ALL HIS DAYS HE ATE NEITHER FAT NOR OIL BUT LIVED ON BREAD AND WATER ONLY; he was A VIRGIN TO THE END; he kept long vigils at night. The Lord NUMBERED HIM AMONG THE SEVENTY, and after the Resurrection APPEARED TO HIM PARTICULARLY, as Paul witnesses in 1 Corinthians 15. BY THE LORD’S OWN DIRECTION HE COMPOSED THE FIRST LITURGY, WHICH WAS TOO LONG FOR LATER CHRISTIANS, SO THAT SAINT BASIL AND SAINT JOHN CHRYSOSTOM HAD TO SHORTEN IT — two folders this corpus holds, and two new `related` rows here, reciprocated in this same commit, because an abbreviation of his own liturgy is his story and not a dedication. THE UNBELIEVING JEWS THEMSELVES WONDERED AT HIS RIGHTEOUSNESS AND CALLED HIM JAMES THE JUST. And the death in full: when АНАН became high priest he and the other elders planned to kill him; at a Passover with a great crowd in Jerusalem THEY TOLD HIM TO GO UP ON THE ROOF OF THE TEMPLE AND SPEAK AGAINST CHRIST, and he went up and preached Christ as the Son of God and the true Messiah, his resurrection and his eternal glory in heaven; THEY PUSHED HIM OFF THE ROOF, he fell and was badly hurt BUT WAS STILL ALIVE, AND A MAN RAN UP AND STRUCK HIM ON THE HEAD SO HARD THAT HIS BRAIN CAME OUT OF HIS HEAD. ONE PERSON NAMED AND NO FOLDER HOLDS HIM, WHICH IS RULING 3: АНАН the high priest. Herod is named and is not a saint. No `office` change, no `locations`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Ca un ucenic al Domnului ai primit Evanghelia, drepte; ca un mucenic eşti de neînduple­cat; îndrăzneală ca un frate al lui Dumnezeu, a te ruga ca un ierarh. Roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu, să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Apostol Iacob, ruda Domnului

english.text: As a disciple of the Lord thou didst receive the Gospel, O righteous one; as a martyr thou art unbending; as a brother of God thou hast boldness; as a hierarch thou canst intercede. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς τοῦ Κυρίου Μαθητής, ἀνεδέξω δίκαιε τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον ὡς Μάρτυς ἔχεις τὸ ἀπαράτρεπτον τὴν παρρησίαν ὡς Ἀδελφόθεος τὸ πρεσβεύειν ὡς Ἱεράρχης. Ἱκέτευε Χριστὸν τὸν Θεόν, σωθήναι τᾶς ψυχᾶς ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος και Αδελφόθεος» — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’ (the page prints no model)

english.text: As a disciple of the Lord, just one, you received the Gospel; as a martyr you have what cannot be turned aside; as the Brother of God, boldness; as a hierarch, the office of intercession. Entreat Christ our God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ὁ τοῦ Πατρὸς μονογενὴς Θεὸς Λόγος, ἐπιδημήσας πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἐπ' ἐσχάτων, τῶv ἡμερῶν Ἰάκωβε θεσπέσιε, πρῶτον σε ἀνέδειξε τῶν Ἱεροσολύμων, Ποιμένα καὶ Διδάσκαλον, καὶ πιστὸν οἰκονόμον, τῶν μυστηρίων τῶv πνευματικῶν, ὄθεv σε πάντες τιμῶμεν Ἀπόστολε.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Ιάκωβος ο Απόστολος και Αδελφόθεος» — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς (copied as the page prints it, Latin v for ν and all)

english.text: The only-begotten God the Word of the Father, having come to dwell among us in the last of the days, declared you, divinely-spoken James, the first shepherd and teacher of Jerusalem, and a faithful steward of the spiritual mysteries; and so we all honour you, apostle.

hymns.text: Яко Господень ученик восприял еси, праведне, Евангелие,/ яко мученик имаши еже неописанное,/ дерзновение яко брат Божий,/ еже молитися яко иерарх:// моли Христа Бога спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостола Иакова»

english.text: As the Lord's disciple you received the Gospel, O righteous one; as a martyr you have what cannot be set aside; as the brother of God, boldness; as a hierarch, the office of prayer. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Отчее Единородное Бог Слово,/ пришедшее к нам в последния дни,/ Иакове Божественне,/ перваго тя показа/ иерусалимлян пастыря и учителя,/ и вернаго строителя таинств духовных:// темже тя вси чтим, апостоле.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Иакова»

english.text: The Father's Only-begotten, God the Word, who came to us in the last days, declared you, divine James, the first shepherd and teacher of the people of Jerusalem and a faithful steward of the spiritual mysteries; therefore we all honour you, apostle.

death.note: Two sources, one year apart, and neither is chosen. saint.gr heads his page «(; - 62)». days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 23 октября ст. ст. «(ок. 63)» and one of its three lives for him says «Мученическая кончина святителя Иакова произошла около 63 года»; another dates the killing by the interval between the departure of the procurator Festus and the arrival of Albinus, «(62 г. после Р. X. )». Read 4 October 2026.
